title: Altinn Studio - App deploys
description: App deploys and undeploys from Altinn Studio, end to end: the deploy request to Designer, the Azure DevOps pipeline Designer queues and polls, Designer's reconcile call to the runtime gateway, and Flux's install or upgrade result, which the gateway passes back to Designer. The counts, failed pipelines and the time each phase took come from Designer's deploy metrics (altinn.designer.app_deploy.*, cicd.pipeline.run.duration), and Flux's results and the hand-off between Designer and the gateways from the gateways' metrics (altinn-studio-metrics). Designer marks every deploy's trace to be kept and the trace continues through the pipeline's HelmRelease into the gateway, so the tables of deploys and the outcomes join each deploy's spans by trace ID (altinn-studio-traces-logsql, LogsQL) to show it as one row, also while it is still running. Filter by the Studio environment that deployed (dev, staging, prod), the environment deployed to and the service owner. Designer's request metrics carry only the Studio environment, and Azure DevOps' queue and run time has no service owner. The Azure DevOps pipeline sends no telemetry of its own, so its steps and failure reasons are not here; Build links to the run. Datasource UIDs are pinned, matching the other Altinn Studio dashboards.

list.name: studio_env
list.label: Studio environment
list.description: Studio environment that deployed the app (Designer's deployment.environment.name, the gateway's altinn.gateway.origin_environment).

list.name: env
list.label: Environment

list.description: Service owner whose app was deployed (altinn.service_owner).

panels.title: Deploys
panels.description: Deploy pipelines Designer queued in the time range (altinn.designer.app_deploy.queued). A request that failed before Designer queued the pipeline is under Failed requests.

panels.title: Failed requests
panels.description: Deploy requests that failed with a server error, most of them before Designer queued the pipeline. Failed and unfinished deploys lists them, with links to their traces.

panels.title: Failed pipelines
panels.description: Deploys in the time range whose Azure DevOps pipeline failed, which ends the deploy, since Designer asks the runtime to reconcile only after a pipeline that succeeded (altinn.designer.app_deploy.duration with result pipeline_failed). A pipeline someone canceled is not a failure. Failed and unfinished deploys lists them, with links to their runs.

panels.title: Flux success rate
panels.description: Installs and upgrades that succeeded, out of all install and upgrade results Flux reported to the runtime gateways in the time range (altinn.gateway.deploy_events). Uninstalls are under Undeploys.

panels.title: Flux failures
panels.description: InstallFailed and UpgradeFailed results from Flux in the time range (altinn.gateway.deploy_events). Designer posts each to the internal Slack channel and the service owner's contact points.

panels.title: Deploy time p50
panels.description: Median time from the deploy request to Flux's install or upgrade result, over the deploys that got one in the time range (altinn.designer.app_deploy.duration), interpolated within the histogram's buckets.

panels.title: Deploy time p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time from the deploy request to Flux's install or upgrade result, over the deploys that got one in the time range (altinn.designer.app_deploy.duration).

panels.title: Undeploys
panels.description: Undeploy pipelines Designer queued in the time range, for undeploys someone asked for and for the nightly undeploy of inactive apps (altinn.designer.app_deploy.queued). Undeploys skipped because one was already pending are not queued.

panels.title: Deploys by environment
panels.description: Deploy pipelines Designer queued per interval, by the environment deployed to (altinn.designer.app_deploy.queued).

panels.title: Flux results by reason
panels.description: Flux's install and upgrade results for apps, as the runtime gateways count them (altinn.gateway.deploy_events), per interval. Uninstalls are under Undeploys.

panels.title: Outcomes
panels.description: Deploys requested in the time range by how far they got, from each deploy's trace: Flux's result (InstallSucceeded, UpgradeSucceeded, InstallFailed, UpgradeFailed); Request failed (Designer answered the deploy request with a server error); Pipeline running or Pipeline failed (Designer is still polling the Azure DevOps pipeline, or stopped without a reconcile call, which it makes only after a pipeline that succeeded); Reconcile failed (Designer could not ask the runtime gateway to reconcile); Waiting for Flux, then No Flux event after 15 minutes (the pipeline succeeded, but no Flux result has come back in the deploy's trace).

panels.title: Time per phase by environment
panels.description: How long deploys took in each environment deployed to, from Designer's deploy metrics. Deploys counts the deploys that ended in the time range, with Flux's result or a pipeline that did not succeed. Pipeline is from the deploy request until Designer saw the Azure DevOps pipeline succeed, within 10 s, so it includes the time queued in Azure DevOps (altinn.designer.app_deploy.pipeline.duration). Flux is from there to Flux's install or upgrade result (altinn.designer.app_deploy.flux.duration). Total is the whole, request to result (altinn.designer.app_deploy.duration). Quantiles are interpolated within the histograms' buckets.

panels.title: Service owners

Failed counts every outcome other than success that is not still in progress: Flux failures, failed requests, pipelines and reconcile calls, and deploys with no Flux event after 15 minutes. Select a column header to sort.

panels.title: Azure DevOps queue and run time
panels.description: How long the deploy pipeline's runs waited in Azure DevOps' queue for an agent (pending) and then ran (executing), p50 and p95 over the hour before each point, from Azure DevOps' own times (cicd.pipeline.run.duration). panels.title: Hand-off between Designer and the runtime
Flux results not passed on to Designer
panels.description: Flux results the runtime gateway could not pass on to the Studio environment that deployed the app, by error.type: helm_release_unresolved when the HelmRelease lacks the labels that name the app and build, otherwise the HTTP status or exception from Designer. Designer then never learns the result, and the deploy shows as waiting.

panels.title: Reconcile requests by status code
panels.description: Designer's requests to the runtime gateways to reconcile an app's Flux resources after a pipeline succeeded, by the gateway's response status. Not filtered by Studio environment.

panels.title: Designer's deploy routes by status code
panels.description: Designer's responses on its deploy routes: deploy (POST .../deployments), undeploy, the deploy list and Flux results from the gateways (.../deployments/webhooks/events). A 404 on webhooks/events is an uninstall with no pending undeploy in Designer. Designer's request metrics have no service owner or environment deployed to, so only the Studio environment filter applies.

panels.title: Failure notifications sent
panels.description: Designer's messages about a failed install, upgrade or uninstall (altinn.designer.notification.deliveries with kind deployment), by audience: the internal Slack channel and the service owner's contact points. A series with an error type is a message that could not be delivered.

panels.title: Undeploys by trigger
panels.description: Undeploy pipelines Designer queued per interval, by what triggered them: manual, when someone asked for the undeploy, or inactivity, the nightly undeploy of an inactive app in at22, at23, at24, tt02 and yt01 (altinn.designer.app_deploy.queued).

panels.title: Uninstall results
panels.description: Flux's uninstall results for apps, as the runtime gateways count them (altinn.gateway.deploy_events), per interval. The HelmRelease is gone by then, so these are not in the undeploy's trace.

panels.title: Skipped undeploys
panels.description: Undeploys Designer skipped because another undeploy of the same app and environment was queued less than 10 minutes earlier (altinn.designer.undeploy.skip_reason), with that undeploy's age and build. Select the build to open its run in Azure DevOps, or a trace ID to open the trace.

panels.title: Recent undeploys
panels.description: The latest 200 undeploys in the time range whose pipeline Designer queued, one per row, from each undeploy's trace. Pipeline is from the request or job until Designer's last poll of the Azure DevOps pipeline. Outcome is Pipeline finished once Designer has asked the runtime gateway to reconcile, which it does only after a pipeline that succeeded; Flux's uninstall result is in Uninstall results. Select a trace ID to open the trace.

panels.title: Deploy warnings and errors
panels.description: Warning and error records about deploys from Designer and the runtime gateways (altinn-studio-logs), newest first, such as a reconcile call that failed, a Flux result Designer did not get, or a HelmRelease without the labels the gateway needs. A record written during a deploy carries its trace ID: open the record and select the trace link.
